commands.name: List fastboot devices
commands.description: List Android devices currently connected in bootloader mode.

commands.name: Read fastboot device information
commands.description: Read the product identifier reported by a fastboot device.

commands.name: Reboot Android device
commands.description: Reboot a connected device from bootloader mode.

commands.name: Reboot to bootloader
commands.description: Restart the device into bootloader mode.

commands.name: Unlock bootloader
commands.description: Unlock a device bootloader; this commonly wipes user data and may void warranty.

commands.name: Flash a partition image
commands.description: Write an image to a device partition. Use only the correct image for the exact device model.

commands.name: Boot a temporary image
commands.description: Boot an image temporarily without flashing it to a partition.

commands.name: Lock bootloader
commands.description: Lock a device bootloader; verify the installed system first because this can make a device unbootable.
